sources.title: LiquidAI/LFM2.5-2.6B-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: LFM2.5 is a new family of hybrid models designed for on-device deployment. It builds on the LFM2 architecture with extended pre-training and reinforcement learning.

sources.title: LFM2.5-2.6B: Deploy Agents Everywhere — Blog — Liquid AI
sources.snippet: LFM2.5-2.6B is an on-device agentic model that plans, calls tools, and runs multi-step tasks at 220 tok/s in under 2.5 GB. Open weights on Hugging Face.
